overview: Cardiac health reflects how well your heart and blood vessels support healthy blood circulation. This score estimates your cardiovascular risk based on factors like blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar, weight, and lifestyle.

Hold your weight and waist measurement steady.
Keep alcohol within low-risk limits, or less.
Take 7 to 9 hours of quality sleep.

Limit salt to support healthy blood pressure.
Choose healthy fats like olive oil.
Eat oily fish 2–3 times a week.
Include plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
exercise_recommendations: Get at least 150 minutes of moderate exercise each week.
Include strength training twice a week.
Add stretching or mobility exercises regularly.
monitoring_recommendations: Check blood pressure and cholesterol during routine visits.
Monitor weight and waist size yearly.
Continue regular blood sugar screening.
